What makes Art Deco jewelry unmistakable? 👇

1 — Geometry: clean lines, symmetry, and bold architectural forms born in the 1920s and '30s.
2 — Contrast: onyx against diamond, ruby against gold — drama in every pairing.
3 — Craftsmanship: fringe drops, lariats, and starbursts hand-set by makers whose work still dazzles a century later.

At Sophia Martin, we seek out these vintage and antique pieces and reimagine them as heirlooms you can wear now — the history kept, the beauty renewed.

Save this if Art Deco speaks to you. 🤎

How to style a statement heirloom for modern wear 🤎

1️⃣ Let it lead — a fringe pendant like the Art Deco Onyx & Ruby Fringe ($1,500) against an open neckline, nothing competing.
2️⃣ Soften it — a lariat worn over a crisp white shirt or knit for everyday elegance.
3️⃣ Layer with restraint — one delicate chain beneath a statement piece; let the heirloom stay the hero.

A vintage piece doesn't need an occasion. The trick is to wear it like it's always been yours — because soon, it will have.
